name: Circa
tagline: Field sensor nodes and an irrigation controller that waters the corners centre-pivot systems miss and predicts needs ahead of time.
problem: Centre-pivot irrigation leaves field corners dry and waters unevenly between inner and outer rings.
solution: ESP32 field nodes report conditions to a dashboard; a turret controller targets unwatered areas; a prediction model plans irrigation; a chatbot answers questions.
demo_moment: Team-described: create field nodes and steer the turret to a dry corner.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “First Place Overall” and “Societal Impact” among 212 submissions.
Targets a concrete geometric flaw in existing irrigation.
Won first overall and a societal-impact prize.

lessons: Name the specific inefficiency (dry corners) and show hardware fixing it.
